experiments.reason: Full normal and allocator ABBA evidence shows the compact mapless/binary-search route is not a production candidate; source exact lookup p50 regresses by roughly 2,751%–3,650% at the indexed 2,048/16,384-part sizes in the retained normal/allocator legs.
Full 30-sample normal and allocator ABBA evidence is retained as a rejected linear-probe/binary-search alternative; mixed point estimates do not authorize production adoption.
Transparent five-sample probe retained before the full run; probe status is negative evidence only.
Transparent five-sample scalar Vec probe retained; it is not promoted to a production claim.
Transparent std prehashed-map probe retained; exact-lookup p50 remains slower across the four corpus sizes in both retained profiles.
Transparent direct hashbrown HashTable probe retained; exact-lookup p50 is slower at the larger corpus sizes in the probe.

The high-sample exact-only ABBA (1,000 samples, 20 warmups) rejects the direct HashTable path: normal p50 exact lookup increases 6.9869%–7.391304% at 256, 2.941176%–7.359307% at 2,047, and 14.718615%–15.584416% at 2,048/16,384.
Transparent shared-PackURI Arc probe retained before the final ABBA; normal source lookup p50 rises 6.37093% at 256 and 7.237402% at 2,047.

Final full 30-sample A1/A2/B1/B2 Arc ABBA is retained as the primary negative result. The normal pooled decision gates are exact p50 +6.09%/+6.96% at 2,048/16,384 parts, source-open +3.38%/+4.30%, and mixed-operation -0.59%/-0.50%; allocator evidence adds three allocation calls, +2,051/+16,387 deallocation calls, and net-live deltas of -65,536/-524,288 bytes at those sizes. Normal source-lookup per-leg p50 also rises 4.857543%–5.493987% at 256 and 6.373402%–6.480684% at 2,047. Allocator timing is observational.
